title: Nest a simple rule
summary: Nesting puts a rule inside another rule.
introduction: Nesting puts a rule inside another rule. Your task: Add a nested p rule that sets a text colour.
learningObjectives: Add a nested p rule that sets a text colour.
Explain the example for nest a simple rule

blocks.text: Nesting puts a rule inside another rule. Sass joins the selectors. This can show that a small part belongs inside a bigger part.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: The outer `.card` rule styles the card itself.
The nested `h2` becomes `.card h2`, meaning a heading inside a card.

blocks.text: The output styles .card and .card h2. Only headings inside a card get the navy colour.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Too many nesting levels make hard-to-change selectors. Keep this example one level deep.
